evals.prompt: Review the staged and unstaged Python changes for regressions. Do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: Inspect both requested diffs and relevant Python behavior, report actionable defects with locations, and leave files and remote state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Review this Azure DevOps pull request using the supplied local diff.
evals.expected_output: Review the local diff without requiring GitHub tooling or posting comments; state any missing remote context.

evals.prompt: Review the current branch; there are no uncommitted changes and the base is not obvious.
evals.expected_output: Establish the intended comparison base without assuming a main or master branch.

evals.prompt: Audit this existing parser file for correctness, even though it has no recent changes.
evals.expected_output: Assess defects in the named existing-code scope rather than excluding them solely because they predate the task.

evals.prompt: Make this function easier to read.
evals.expected_output: Do not select the review-only skill as the implementation workflow; use explicit simplification behavior instead.

evals.prompt: Check the changes to the API and client repositories together.
evals.expected_output: Establish each repository target separately and evaluate relevant interface compatibility without merging unrelated diffs.

evals.prompt: The test-first implementation is green. Assess whether extracting a helper is worth a separate refactor; do not change code.
evals.expected_output: Evaluate the benefit, scope, risks, validation and no-change option, separate recommendations from defects, and make no edits without authorization.
